dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper-left flank exhibit thin, serrated high-intensity perimeters with a sharp gradient transition to lower-intensity centers. One primary annulus located mid-dorsal displays a fragmented, high-contrast border with a diameter of approximately 15-20% of the visible torso width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Small, solid light-pixel clusters without internal gradients are concentrated in a medium-density band along the upper dorsal ridge and near the neck junction. Core pixel concentrations are highest in localized clusters situated between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form a distinct obtuse triangle. A series of four high-intensity blobs located along the upper dorsal line creates a roughly linear arrangement oriented parallel to the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex 'chain-link' grouping of several small, interlocking annuli is visible on the posterior lateral surface, creating a unique cluster pattern distinct from the more isolated rings on the anterior sections.
